description: Raditz's space pod: a small round grey-blue pod, a sphere 2 m wide sitting on the ground, with a round pink porthole in a thick black frame on a door cut out of its front, which swings forward and down on a hinge and 2 metal arms.
layout: Middle: the round grey-blue hull, a full sphere 2 wide (x -1 to 1, z -1 to 1, y 0 to 2), with no base and no legs: 2 domes with the same center 1 above the ground, the top half and the bottom half (tilt 180). Its lowest point touches the ground. Front: the door is a part of the sphere's own quads (the pod block): from the 3rd row under the top point, 3 quads wide and 6 quads high, from -54 to 54 degrees of elevation and 38.57 degrees each side of the front. It turns forward and down around a hinge line along x at y 0.19, z 0.52 (its bottom edge), by up to 62 degrees, where its top edge rests on the ground. A blue-grey hinge bar (0.3 long) lies inside the hull at the bottom of the opening, and 2 blue-grey arms, one on each side, go from inside the pod to inside the door; closed, all of them are inside the sphere. Colors (flat, no texture): the hull light grey-blue; on the door a round porthole 0.75 wide, pink glass in a thick black frame, its center 10 degrees above the widest line, which shows inside the door too; the inside of the pod and of the door white. The crater of the reference is not part of the building.
